messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary healthcheck failures detected - route: /v1/generate (model-gamma-v4) in us-west-2. 5xx rate > 8% over 3m. Auto-safety threshold exceeded. Paging on-call.

alice_oncall: saw it, joining. grabbing logs + rolling policy.

bob_sre: confirming - curl to /health returns 200 but runtime/worker 5xx on generate. Likely model instance OOMs or kvcache miss storms. pulled recent canary logs: ```2024-11-05T21:14:02Z ERROR serve: allocate failed: CUDA OOM
2024-11-05T21:14:03Z 5xx count=42 window=2m
2024-11-05T21:14:10Z route /v1/generate latency p95=2.1s```

alice_oncall: thanks. what's customer visible? eva_support, do you see increased error reports?

eva_support: support queue shows ~18 customer requests in last hour, mostly aborted generations and timeouts. CSAT flags on a few paid teams. Marking SLO impact = partial (some users degraded).

bob_sre: recommend immediate rollback to previous canary variant and trigger kill-switch for the feature flag routing new traffic. I'll run the commands.

alice_oncall: go for it. I can handle pager and communications.

bob_sre: running: `./deployctl rollback --env=staging --route=/v1/generate --to=gamma-v3`

bob_sre: rollback initiated. hitting feature flag console: toggling `route-gamma-v4` -> OFF for canary cohort. link: https://console.redwood.local/flags/route-gamma-v4

bob_sre: feature flag off, rollback finished. healthchecks starting to stabilize. 5xx rate down to 1.2% in 90s.

alice_oncall: monitoring metrics dashboard: p95 back to ~600ms, errors trending down. notifying #pager-duty and ops. @dave_pm FYI — may want to notify affected customers.

dave_pm: thanks. I'll draft a short incident update for customers: note a degraded experience for some canary users, roll back to earlier model, mitigation complete, follow-up postmortem forthcoming.

carla_eng: can you capture the exact instances that OOMed? I'll collect core dumps and model config. Also request the canary config for batch sizes and quantization settings.

bob_sre: saving instance IDs: i-0aab12... and i-0bbf34... attaching to incident ticket #INC-2024-455. Also exporting canary config: `batch_max_tokens=1024, dynamic_quant=true` — suspect quant path regression.

alice_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 10m. @bob_sre you're on carry to complete root cause and postmortem. @carla_eng please partner on analysis. I'll post final update when I sign off.

bob_sre: ack. will own RCA + postmortem. setting follow-up: assign to carla_eng, bob_sre.

eva_support: logged customers notified, CS engaged for top 3 accounts that reported errors.

alice_oncall: closing on-call thread. last check: 5xx < 2%, routing stable. reopening if it flares. :white_check_mark:
